title: Operations Controlling Analyst
description:
**Operations Controlling Analyst:** 




 In this role, you will be responsible for providing standardized operations controlling and financial performance analysis across multiple global manufacturing sites, ensuring accurate reporting, cost transparency, and KPI management
 



  





**Your job:** 



* Provide standardized global operations controlling analysis and reports for multiple production sites worldwide, with a particular focus on manufacturing order performance, product cost transparency and variance reporting
* Ensure consistent definitions, methodologies, and high data quality across all reports. • Collect, validate, and consolidate data from different plants in close collaboration with local controllers while taking site\-specific requirements and challenges into account
* Analyze operational and financial performance such as costs, productivity, and variances, highlight key trends and deviations and discuss the results with the individual plants
* Support the further standardization and harmonization of reporting structures, KPIs, templates, by working closely with the plants and helping translate central requirements into practical solutions
* Act as a central reporting and consulting interface between global governance and local operations controlling teams
* Support ad\-hoc analyses and management requests related to global operations controlling



  





**Your qualification:** 



* 7 \-10 Years experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Controlling, Business Administration, CMA Inter / Qualified CMA
* Professional experience in an operations controlling position with a good understanding of operations controlling and manufacturing\-related processes (e.g. cost structures, variances, productivity KPIs) and the ability to connect financial data with operational drivers.
* Strong analytical and conceptual skills with a structured, detail\-oriented and solution\-driven working style.
* Very good knowledge of Excel; experience with BI tools (e.g. Power BI, SAP BW, or similar) and a strong interest in automation, digitalization, and AI\-supported analytics are an advantage
* Practical experience with SAP systems (e.g. SAP CO, FI, MM, PP, BW), including data extraction and report preparation
* Ability to work effectively with global stakeholders across different cultures and functions with a consulting mindset and with the ability to build trust, understand plant\-specific requirements, and balance central standards with practical local needs
* Strong communication skills in English with the ability to explain figures and analyses in a clear and concise way



  





**Advantage of your position:** 
 Close proximity to the local Operations Controlling team, providing the opportunity to gain a deep understanding of processes, challenge existing structures, and continuously improve reporting quality and relevance.

title: Group Head - Int Finance CoE
description:
**Summary**
 About the role:
   

  

 The Group Head, International Finance Center of Excellence, leads a high\-performing finance team providing strategic business planning, financial analytics and decision support to Head BPA of country. The role serves as a key finance business partner to BPA, CFO in driving financial transparency, operational excellence, data\-driven decision\-making, and continuous process innovation across geographies.
   

  

 This position is responsible for establishing best\-in\-class financial planning and analysis capabilities, delivering actionable insights, enabling resource allocation decisions, and advancing digital transformation initiatives that improve forecasting accuracy, efficiency, and business outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Key Requirements:**
* Strategic Business Partnership: Partner with country BPA team to support strategy execution and business priorities. Provide financial insights and recommendations to optimize investments, resource allocation, and profitability.
* Financial Planning \& Analysis: Support budgeting, forecasting, latest outlooks, strategic plans, and month\-end reviews. Deliver comprehensive analyses of actuals versus plan, forecast, and prior year performance. Drive understanding of key business drivers, risks, opportunities, and performance trends.
* Performance Management \& Reporting: Establish standardized KPI frameworks and business performance dashboards. Provide insightful management reporting to leadership teams.
* CoE Leadership \& Capability Building: Lead, coach, and develop a diverse team of finance professionals and foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and innovation. Drive standardization, simplification, and harmonization of finance processes across markets. Build organizational capabilities in analytics, automation, and business partnering.
* Data, Analytics \& Digital Transformation: Champion automation and AI\-enabled solutions to improve finance processes and decision support. Drive development of self\-service reporting and advanced analytics capabilities.
* Ensure high\-quality master data governance and scalable reporting solutions. Leverage technologies such as Power BI, Power Query, Power Apps, GenAI, and digital finance tools to enhance productivity and insights.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Data \& Digital, and Global BPA teams. Align regional and local financial processes with global standards.
* Support organizational transformation and change management initiatives. Facilitate knowledge sharing and best\-practice adoption across the international organization.


**Essential Requirements**
* Professional qualification required (ACCA/CIMA/CPA/CA/MBA Finance, or equivalent).
* 10 \+ years of experience in FP\&A, BPA, Finance Business Partnering, or Commercial Finance.
* Proven leadership experience managing global or regional finance teams. Experience supporting Global functions within a complex multinational environment.
* Strong track record in strategic planning, forecasting, performance management, and business partnering.
* Strong knowledge of financial planning and reporting processes with expertise in Excel, Power BI, Power Query, and reporting technologies. Knowledge of SAP, BPC is a plus.
* Experience with automation, digital finance solutions, and AI\-enabled analytics. Strong understanding of resource allocation and investment governance methodologies.


**Desirable Requirements**
* Influence strategic decisions through data\-driven financial insights.
* Build a best\-in\-class BPA CoE delivering scalable and efficient finance services.
* Drive operational excellence through standardization and automation.
* Develop a highly engaged, high\-performing finance organization that supports International growth and transformation.

title: Senior Analyst Project Financial Control
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

 PURPOSE
   

  

 The Senior Analyst Project Financial Controller is responsible for providing high\-quality financial reporting, forecasting, review, and analysis to support Project Managers and Delivery teams, ensuring compliance with deadlines, financial governance, and quality requirements. He/She is responsible for driving effective project financial control and acting as a Finance Champion within his/her remit to ensure compliance with SITA policies, processes, accounting standards, and financial guidelines. The role reports to the Manager Project Financial Control.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with Project Managers to provide clear visibility of project financial performance against approved Business Cases and contractual commitments.
* Ensure effective financial handover from the sales cycle into project execution, validating supporting documentation including contracts, approved Business Cases, and commercial assumptions.
* Establish and maintain project financial structures, controls, and reporting mechanisms to enable effective project tracking and governance.
* Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and financial plans throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with project objectives and expected outcomes.
* Lead project revenue recognition, billing validation, profitability analysis, and P\&L monitoring to ensure accurate financial reporting and performance tracking.
* Perform regular reviews of project actuals, analyze variances against budget and forecast, and provide financial insights and recommendations to Project Managers and key stakeholders.
* Manage project financial activities during month\-end close, including accruals, deferrals, asset and inventory tracking, and balance sheet monitoring in partnership with accounting teams.
* Prepare and present monthly project financial reports, highlighting project performance, key risks, contingency utilization, opportunities, and forecast changes to support project governance reviews and decision\-making.
* Support Project Review Boards (PRBs) and portfolio reviews by providing financial analysis, forecasting updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to improve project profitability and cash performance.
* Provide guidance and support to Project Financial Controllers across the portfolio, promoting financial control best practices, consistency in reporting, compliance with IAS/IFRS standards, and successful project closeout and handover to operations.


**Qualifications**
 EXPERIENCE
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualifications (CA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent) preferred.
* 3\-5 years of experience in Project Finance, Financial Control, Project Accounting, FP\&A, or Business Finance roles.
* Strong understanding of project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and project profitability management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.


**Nice\-to\-have**
* Experience supporting technology, aviation, telecommunications, or infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, OneStream, Power BI, or similar financial reporting systems.
* Experience working within IFRS reporting environments and global project governance frameworks.


**Education \& Qualifications**

title: R2R Financial Accountant
description:
**We Are?** 




 We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects.
 



 For over 50 years, we've been energizing our clients across the world with unrivalled expertise, equipment, and technology that supports the entire asset life\-cycle offshore and on land.
 



 We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure \& Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions.
 



 Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline and subsea, process, and valves all designed to help our clients optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency.
 



 With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way.
   





**The Role** 




 The RTR Finance accountant role is responsible for transactional and operational delivery within the Record to Report (RTR) function of the Shared Services Centre (SSC). This role ensures the accurate and timely processing of financial transactions and reporting, execution of month\-end and year\-end close activities, and provides essential assistance to the RTR Team Lead and Process Tower Lead to maintain high standards of service delivery across multiple geographies.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Transaction Processing
* Accurately process journal entries as per the month end close calendar or ad\-hoc as requested by Geography finance team (e.g. adjustments, re\-allocations, corrections)
* Prepare supporting documents, refresh reports necessary for calculation of journal values. Raise queries and gather information required for journals calculation and preparation
* Prepare journal templates, check dimensions, GL codes, date, entity, upload and post transactions in ERP. Submit journals for approval in accordance with Level of authority and policies in place
* Support the planning and allocation of tasks of routine and ad hoc transactions in the ticketing system. Use the ticketing system for execution and monitoring of tasks
* Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring all items are supported and unreconciled items are investigated, escalated and action plan defined
* Month\-End and Year\-End Close
* Provide operational support for month\-end and year\-end close activities, including data gathering, transaction processing, and report generation



**The Requirements** 




 Key Skills \& Experience
 


* Experience in shared services, in a Record to Report accounting role
* A minimum of 10 years experience in an Accounting roles
* Working knowledge of ERP systems (Navision), proficiency in Microsoft Excel, preferable reporting Power BI experience
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and delivery on time as per the SLAs
* Good organisational and time management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines
* Effective communication skills and a collaborative approach to teamwork
* Willingness to work various shift patterns aligned to supported geographies (e.g., Europe/UK, Australia, Americas, UAE, India) as required by the SSC operating model.



**Diversity \& Inclusion** 




 EnerMech is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive organisation. We believe that diversity enriches our team, and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, cultures, and identities. You will have good organisational and time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines, along with effective communication skills.

description:
**Company Description**
 Medicine moves forward here. So will you.
   

  

 At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.
   

  

 We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post\-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.
   

  

 That work takes curious minds, problem\-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.
   

  

 If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Support the Project Finance team in monitoring project profitability and financial performance. Work alongside Project Managers and operational project teams to develop a foundational understanding of project economics, including tracking forecasts, identifying risks to margins, and learning process improvements.  Specific benefits vary by location

title: Analyst

title: Quantitative Analyst — Decision Intelligence (Equipment Finance)
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About Us We are an AI\-driven analytics platform startup focused on building automated decision\-making solutions. Our current focus is Athena, our decision intelligence product for the equipment finance industry — helping lenders turn underwriting, risk, and portfolio data into real\-time, automated decisions. Role Overview This is the core quantitative role behind Athena's decision intelligence products — not a generalist business analyst or PM role. You'll own translating complex financial and risk logic into specifications our data engineering team can build against, and validate that the resulting pipelines produce numbers that are actually correct. The bar here is quantitative reasoning and data fluency, not years of BA/PM titles. There will be a structured transition period supported by our outgoing product lead. What You'll Own Translate complex business and financial logic — equipment lease valuation (net investment method, true present value at contractual rate, fair value at current market rate), risk\-based pricing, portfolio risk concentration, vintage curve analysis, macro\-to\-industry credit risk sensitivity — into specs engineers can build against Design and evolve data pipelines iteratively: identify and specify the derived/ancillary tables needed as logic gets built out (e.g., a present\-value table that has to exist before a concentration calculation can run on top of it) Validate model outputs directly against the database — pull raw and transformed data, sanity\-check that logic was applied correctly, and catch anomalies before they reach production (e.g., an implausible vintage projection) Own the implementation judgment calls — null handling, edge cases, and the steady stream of clarifying questions that surface as engineers build out the logic Build and maintain real working knowledge of the schema — data type quirks, which values are stored raw vs. derived — so business logic maps cleanly onto what's actually in the tables Work directly with the founder to turn high\-level business requirements into precise, unambiguous logic Must\-Have Strong quantitative background — applied math, statistics, economics, engineering, actuarial science, or similar Strong SQL — comfortable writing and debugging complex queries directly against Postgres to validate outputs, not just reading dashboards built by others Real comfort with quantitative financial reasoning — time value of money, risk and probability concepts (equipment/lease finance exposure is a strong plus, not required) Ability to break an ambiguous business problem into a precise, step\-by\-step logical flow High agency — comfortable being the primary translation layer between founder and engineering with minimal oversight Nice\-to\-Have Background in credit risk, actuarial work, or quantitative/statistical modeling within lending, NBFC, or fintech Exposure to data pipeline concepts (ETL, orchestration tools like Dagster, layered bronze\-to\-gold architecture) FRM/CFA (partial or full) or equivalent quantitative finance coursework — not required, but signals the right reasoning muscle What We Offer Full\-time role with a structured transition period, supported directly by the outgoing product lead Direct ownership of the hardest, most central problem in the product — not ticket execution Direct access to the founder and outsized influence over how the product's core logic is built A small, sharp team solving a genuinely hard problem in equipment finance Compensation ₹10–12 LPA, fixed cash, based on experience and demonstrated quantitative/data fluency. No equity component for this role.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 \['Data Analysis SQL Applied Mathematics Quantitative Finance Credit Underwriting Credit \& Risk Management']
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 NA

title: Supply Chain Analyst

**Life tastes better with ice cream**
 With 19\.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben \& Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
   

  

 We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
   

  

**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
 We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
   

  

 We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Finance Junior Manager gives support to the (alternatively) Materials / Factory / Logistics / Supply Chain Overheads and Business Waste respective teams by performing various day to day operational activities for them, discussing, and sharing relevant information and assumptions behind these activities so that European finance teams and countries can concentrate on their core business partnering tasks.
   

  

 What you'll be responsible for
   

  

 Ensure Knowledge transfer is OTIF from old SCFS Teams in Unilever ahead of the end of the TSA (Temporary Service Agreement) by end 2026\.
   

  

 Act as first point of contact for the respective Cost Bucket Owners in Europe and all its countries and factories covering localization process of Opus Design (New SAP) representing EU processes,
   

  

 Being the linking pin between the internal Cost Buckets Owners and the team members in charge of transfer pricing and intercompany flows
   

  

 Coordinate the Business Plan \& Quarterly TP update processes between GBS team and 3rd party subcontractors where applicable
   

  

 Facilitate the Transfer Price corrections and strengthen the controls process identifying together with Unilever SCFS the root causes
   

  

 Deliver understanding \& transparency of Supply Chain cost developments (Actuals vs. Forecast) for the Cost Bucket in scope
   

  

 Maintain and develop various TP reporting using relevant tools (Power BI, Power Query etc.)
   

  

 Lead projects for further development of the analytical support provided to the external stakeholders
   

  

 Lead projects for continuous improvement in team processes
   

  

 We're looking for someone who
   

  

 University degree in Finance (minimum Bachelor)
   

  

 Minimum of 4 years of finance working experience preferably in finance business partnering
   

  

 Excellent MS Excel Skills. Power BI/ Power Query is required.
   

  

 Effective Communication: Fluent in English, oral and written.
   

  

 Analytical thinking, problem solving attitude.
   

  

 Financial Accounting and Reporting knowledge
   

  

 Effective Prioritization and Problem\-solving attitude
   

  

 Forward looking approach and ability to provide “what if” analysis
   

  

 Multiple Stakeholders Management
   

  

 IT skills – excellent level of computer literacy (incl excel \& SAP)
   

  

 Motivation to build up own agenda
   

  

 Team working – demonstrate commitment to the team in helping to achieve goals; proactively share best practice, ideas and insights with colleagues
   

  

 Agility and ability to adjust quickly to the changes
   

  

 What you'll get
   

  

 Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
   

  

 Market\-competitive pay and performance related rewards
   

  

 Flexible ways of working
   

  

 Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
   

  

 Time off to rest and recharge
   

  

 Ongoing learning and development opportunities
   

  

 Specific benefits vary by location
   

  

**Why join us?**
 This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed \- both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end\-to\-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
   

  

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
   

  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.


 Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
 If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Finance & Accounts Manager
description:
**About The Company**
 Our client is a fast\-growing, conscious footwear brand transforming everyday comfort with innovative engineering and sustainable materials. Featuring high\-performance cushioning and proprietary biodegradable technology, they craft open footwear built for style, function, and minimal environmental impact. They are seeking talented professionals to help scale the future of sustainable fashion across India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Finance \& Accounts professional to manage end\-to\-end finance operations, statutory compliances, management reporting, and business finance activities. The ideal candidate should possess strong accounting knowledge, analytical skills, and the ability to work closely with management, auditors, investors, vendors, and customers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Financial Reporting \& MIS:
+ Prepare monthly MIS including Profit \& Loss Account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and variance analysis.
+ Monitor key business KPIs and provide actionable insights to management.
+ Prepare budget vs actual reports and departmental performance analysis.
+ Support annual budgeting and forecasting exercises.

* Investor \& Management Reporting:
+ Prepare periodic investor reports and management presentations.
+ Assist in financial modelling, fundraising, due diligence, and data room management.
+ Support Board and management reporting requirements.

* Accounting \& Financial Control:
+ Ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts.
+ Manage month\-end and year\-end closing activities.
+ Review journal entries, provisions, accruals, and reconciliations.
+ Implement and strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs.

* GST, TDS \& Statutory Compliance:
+ Ensure timely filing of GST returns (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, Annual Returns, Reconciliations).
+ Manage TDS deductions, payments, return filings, and reconciliations.
+ Coordinate with consultants and authorities for tax assessments and notices.
+ Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory regulations.

* Vendor \& Customer Reconciliations:
+ Perform periodic vendor and customer account reconciliations.
+ Resolve discrepancies and ensure accurate accounting records.
+ Monitor receivables and payables aging.
+ Coordinate with business teams for timely collections and payments.

* Banking \& Treasury:
+ Manage banking operations, fund flow, and cash flow planning.
+ Prepare cash flow forecasts and working capital reports.
+ Coordinate with banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions for funding requirements.

* Audit \& Compliance:
+ Coordinate with statutory, internal, GST, and tax auditors.
+ Prepare schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents for audits.
+ Ensure timely closure of audit observations and compliance matters.

* ERP \& Process Improvement:
+ Work on ERP systems and ensure data integrity.
+ Drive automation initiatives and process improvements.
+ Develop reports and dashboards to improve decision\-making.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* MBA (Finance), M.Com, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification.
* 5–10 years of experience in Finance \& Accounts.
* Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting standards, and financial reporting.
* Experience with ERP systems and advanced Excel.
* Exposure to investor reporting and fundraising activities will be an added advantage.


**Required Skills**
* Financial Analysis \& MIS Reporting
* Accounting \& Finalization of Accounts
* GST \& TDS Compliance
* Budgeting \& Forecasting
* Cash Flow Management
* Vendor \& Customer Reconciliations
* Audit Coordination
* Advanced Excel \& ERP Systems
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Timely closure of monthly accounts and MIS.
* Accuracy of financial reports and reconciliations.
* Zero major compliance delays or penalties.
* Improvement in receivable collections and working capital.
* Timely submission of investor and management reports.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and controls.

description:

 Apollo is a high\-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk\-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth.  Our Clients Rely On Our Investment Acumen To Help Secure Their Future. We Must Never Lose Our Focus And Determination To Be The Best Investors And Most Trusted Partners On Their Behalf. We Strive To Be

Our breadth and scale enable us to deliver capital for even the largest projects – and our small firm mindset ensures we will be a thoughtful and dedicated partner to these organizations. We are committed to helping them build stronger businesses.
   

  

 A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.
   

  

 We are building a unique firm of extraordinary colleagues who:
   

  

 Outperform expectations
   

  

 Challenge Convention
   

  

 Champion Opportunity
   

  

 Lead responsibly

**Our Benefits**
 Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Apollo is looking for candidates to join its Credit Underwriting team in the Credit Research team which is split across multiple sectors. As part of the team, the candidate will work alongside respective sector leads and Portfolio Managers to maximize the return potential of investments while also collaborating with the larger Credit Research team. The role is a blend of Team Lead and Individual Contributor the candidate will be responsible for leading a team of analysts on the credit analysis as well as maintaining / initiating coverage on a portfolio of issuers. The candidate, together with the larger Analyst team, will be responsible for evaluating the credit quality of issuers and support lead analyst on primary and secondary deals while monitoring existing exposures. The candidate should have a good understanding of one or many fixed income asset classes, such as Investment Grade, High Yield Bonds or Leveraged Loans. The candidate should have prior experience in delivering end\-to\-end Credit Research solutions, having worked on developing extensive financial models with scenario analysis and preparing Investment Memos. The candidate must possess strong written and verbal communication skills, effectively manage client/stakeholder requirements and ensure their timely execution, while consistently delivering high\-quality and impactful research. The candidate should demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and be capable of conducting thorough quality checks (QC)
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Managing Credit Research engagements where the Analyst Team is involved in initiating / monitoring single name corporate credit situations in US/EU/APAC markets as part of the engagement, the team performs investment research, including:
   

  

* Building detailed financial models with KPI driven Revenue projections, Cost drivers, Working capital analysis, Capex schedule, Capital Structure analysis, Covenant analysis, Default \& Recovery workouts and IRR sensitivities and valuations.
* Creating a finalized product: Preparing Investment Memos including identification of investment catalysts and provide recommendations IG instruments. This is a fundamental analysis role.
* Presenting the primary/secondary deals to the investment committee and clearly articulating your opinion. Take full ownership of the investment view and continuously monitor key developments affecting the issuers credit quality.
* Maintain portfolio coverage including regular model updates and earning summary write\-ups.
* Checking the work of and training younger analysts, as required.
* Driving Systemic Quality mindset across teams, implement and maintain best research delivery practices.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MBA or equivalent in Finance /CFA/CA
* Experience: 7\-12 Years
* Industry experience: PE / Investment Banking / Credit Research with high modelling skills
* Experience supporting equity research and/or FIG(M\&A) at banks or PE firms. Ideally modelling writing reports.
* Excellent corporate credit analysis skills from a fundamental perspective.
* Proficiency in building detailed financial models and preparing investment memos besides having excellent analytical skills
* Generalist with sector exposure in any of TMT, IT, Healthcare, Autos, Manufacturing, Oil \& Gas, Chemical sectors, Utilities or corporate finance background in a sell side firm. Thorough understanding of accounting.
* Proficiency in using Databases \& Portfolio Asset Management Systems \- Bloomberg, CapIQ.
* Ability to work under pressure and deliver high\-quality research.
* Prior record of having worked on competitive Pilots will be an added advantage


*Apollo provides equal employment opportunities regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, veteran status, gender/sex or sexual orientation, or any other criterion or circumstance protected by applicable law, ordinance, or regulation. The above criteria are intended to be used as a guide only – candidates who do not meet all the above criteria may still be considered if they are deemed to have relevant experience/ equivalent levels of skill or knowledge to fulfil the requirements of the role. Any job offer will be conditional upon and subject to satisfactory reference and background screening checks, all necessary corporate and regulatory approvals or certifications as required from time to time, and entering definitive contractual documentation satisfactory to Apollo.*

 , completed on April 8, 2022\. The company's name is a combination from the

  film studio and the

**The Role** 






  
 





 The Senior Associate is responsible for preparing, analyzing, and delivering financial data and reports from S4 accounting records to support statutory reporting activities across multiple EMEA legal entities. The role focuses on ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timely provision of financial information required by the EMEA Statutory team and local providers.
 












**Key Responsibilities** 






**Financial Data and Reporting Support** 




* Prepare and deliver financial data extracts, reports, and analyses from US GAAP accounting records to support statutory reporting processes
* Ensure data provided to the EMEA Statutory team is accurate, complete, and submitted within required deadlines
* Reconcile and validate financial information across multiple reporting sources
* Investigate data variances and resolve reporting discrepancies in collaboration with relevant finance teams
* Maintain documentation supporting reported balances and financial analyses



**Financial Information Management** 



* Compile and organize financial information required for statutory accounts preparation and regulatory reporting
* Provide supporting documents, schedules, reconciliations, and detailed financial analysis upon request
* Maintain reporting templates and standardized datasets to support consistent reporting practices
* Assist in the preparation of recurring and ad hoc management reports



**Data Quality and Controls** 



* Perform data validation checks to ensure integrity and accuracy of financial information
* Support compliance with internal controls and financial reporting policies
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, standardization, and data quality
* Maintain clear audit trails and documentation supporting reported figures



**Stakeholder Support** 



* Collaborate with accounting, RTR, controlling, and statutory reporting teams across the EMEA region
* Respond to requests for financial information and provide supporting explanations of reported results
* Support finance projects and initiatives that require financial data analysis and reporting expertise





















**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in accounting, Finance or qualified/semi\-qualified CA, CMA or a related discipline
* 2\-4 years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, record\-to\-report (RTR), or finance operations
* Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting data structures
* Experience working with large datasets and performing financial reconciliations
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms
* Knowledge of US GAAP reporting principles is preferred




  
   



**Key Competencies** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Effective communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to interpret and explain financial information
* Continuous improvement mindset and focus on process efficiency















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at

 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ\-EQ**
 We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end\-to\-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 6,500\+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top\-15 private equity firms.
   

  

 Our services are underpinned by a Group\-wide commitment to ESG and best\-in\-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in\-house experts.
   

  

 Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.
   

  

 We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Introduction**
 As a Manager in Client Services, you will lead high\-performing teams responsible for private equity fund accounting, financial reporting, and client service delivery. This role focuses on driving business growth, developing talent, ensuring operational excellence, maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, and delivering accurate, timely, and compliant services while supporting complex client requirements and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* You'll lead, coach, and develop Client Services teams, monitoring performance, managing workloads, providing feedback, and driving continuous improvement to achieve quality, productivity, and timeliness targets.
* You'll oversee the review and delivery of complex private equity fund accounting activities, including NAV calculations, financial statements, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, journal entries, and other client reporting requirements.
* You'll build and maintain strong relationships with clients, cluster counterparts, and internal stakeholders, managing escalations, resolving issues, facilitating performance discussions, and ensuring service levels and client expectations are met.
* You'll ensure compliance with internal policies, procedures, SSAE requirements, and risk management standards by reviewing deliverables, monitoring controls, approving compliance reports, and driving corrective and preventive actions when needed.
* You'll support operational and strategic projects by facilitating fund onboarding and system migrations to Investran/Paxus, managing workflow planning and resource allocation, serving as a subject matter expert, and acting as an alternate to the Head of Delivery when required.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health \& Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances \& Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.


**Qualifications**
**About You**
* You have a degree in Accounting or a business\-related discipline, 8\+ years of relevant accounting experience, and at least 4 years of people management or supervisory experience in a service delivery environment.

title: Senior SME Consolidation
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary**
  

 NIQ is seeking a Senior SME – Consolidations to partner with the Global Process Owner (GPO) in managing and continuously improving the global consolidation and close process.
   

  

 This role is instrumental in ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of NIQ’s consolidated financial results, embedding robust governance, automation, and process standardisation across regions.
   

  

 The Senior SME acts as the technical deputy to the GPO, providing operational oversight, subject\-matter guidance, and analytical insights across the consolidation lifecycle. The role will also contribute to NIQ’s broader R2R transformation agenda, supporting initiatives under Project Compass and RTR Quality Board.
   

  

  

  





**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Consolidation and Reporting**
  

 • Lead execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidations for NIQ entities in OneStream, ensuring accuracy and adherence to close timelines.
   

  

 • Validate consolidation entries, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation adjustments to ensure first\-time\-right financial results.
   

  

 • Partner with Corporate Accounting and Controllership to finalise management and statutory consolidation packs and ensure alignment of group reporting.
   

  

 • Support the GPO in monitoring Close Cockpit milestones and escalation management during close cycles.
   

  





**Governance and Standardisation**
  

 • Maintain and update process documentation, SOPs, and L4 process maps for the consolidation process.
   

  

 • Ensure consistency in consolidation methodologies, data mapping, and chart\-of\-accounts alignment across legal entities.
   

  

 • Support GPO in embedding internal controls (SOX) and ensuring full audit readiness across regions.
   

  

 • Perform process quality reviews and recommend corrective actions for control and reconciliation gaps.
   

  





**Technology and Automation**
  

 • Act as OneStream system SME, supporting configuration changes, system testing, and enhancement requests.
   

  

 • Partner with Enablement and IT to deliver automation and analytics initiatives (RPA, Power BI dashboards, consolidation exception reporting).
   

  

 • Develop and maintain standardised consolidation templates, mapping tables, and validation scripts.
   

  





**Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement**
  

 • Liaise with regional controllers, service delivery leads, and corporate accounting teams to ensure smooth consolidation execution and issue resolution.
   

  

 • Provide technical accounting and system support for mergers, acquisitions, and entity restructures.
   

  

 • Collaborate with FP\&A and Corporate Reporting teams to provide insights into consolidated P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow results.
   

  





**Continuous Improvement and Capability Building**
  

 • Drive root\-cause analysis of consolidation issues and lead remediation actions.
   

  

 • Support GPO in developing and delivering training modules for RTR teams on consolidation best practices.
   

  

 • Contribute to process transformation projects aimed at shortening the close cycle and improving data accuracy.
   

  





**Required Skills and Attributes
   

  

 Core Skills**
  

 • Deep technical expertise in global consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
   

  

 • Strong understanding of end\-to\-end RTR processes, including their interlinkages with FP\&A, Tax, and Controllership.
   

  

 • Hands\-on proficiency in OneStream, Hyperion, or equivalent EPM systems; good knowledge of SAP data structures and ledger logic (0L/1L).
   

  

 • In\-depth knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS, particularly consolidation accounting, equity method, and non\-controlling interests.
   

  

 • Proven experience in managing financial close governance, reconciliation frameworks, and control compliance.
   

  

 • Ability to interpret and communicate complex accounting and system issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

  

  





**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills (Modelled on GPO Capabilities)**
  

 • Process Excellence Mindset: Passion for continuous improvement, simplification, and first\-time\-right delivery.
   

  

 • Analytical Rigor: Ability to deep\-dive into data, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights.
   

  

 • Influence Without Authority: Collaborates effectively across time zones, driving alignment without direct hierarchy.
   

  

 • Execution Discipline: Strong planning, prioritisation, and follow\-through to meet global close deadlines.
   

  

 • Change Agility: Comfortable working in a transformation environment with evolving systems and structures.
   

  

 • Stakeholder Stewardship: Builds trust with Controllers, SDLs, and Corporate Accounting through reliability and responsiveness.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
   

  

 • Professional qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 • 10–15 years of experience in Finance Operations, with at least 5 years in consolidation or group reporting.
   

  

 • Prior experience in global consolidation and reporting for multinational organisations is essential.
   

  

 • Exposure to OneStream or Hyperion implementations, process transformation, and automation initiatives desirable.
   

  





**Success Profile**
  

 • Operates as the technical backbone of NIQ’s global consolidation process.
   

  

 • Acts as the operational deputy to the GPO, ensuring process execution excellence and data integrity.
   

  

 • Demonstrates strong technical, analytical, and leadership maturity, preparing for future progression to process\-ownership roles.

Senior Revenue Accountant Finance
 



  





 AppZen is an AI\-first automation platform for finance teams, covering the full spend\-to\-pay lifecycle — from invoice processing and expense auditing to accounts payable and corporate card review. Our AI platform integrates with customers' existing systems to reduce manual effort, errors, fraud, and compliance risk, giving finance and accounting teams the tools to operate more strategically and scale without adding headcount.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 As a member of the Finance team, the Senior Revenue Accountant will own operational revenue accounting and compliance at AppZen.This role reviews, analyzes, and approves customer contracts and revenue arrangements under ASC 606, drives the month\-end revenue close, and partners closely with AR \& Collections, Deal Desk, GTM, and FP\&A to ensure revenue, deferred revenue, and receivable balances are accurate, well\-documented, and audit\-ready. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, motivated, and thrives in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. This is initially an individual contributor role, with the expectation that it will grow into a managerial position as the Revenue Accounting function scales.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



 • Manage daily revenue accounting operations — review, analyze, and approve customer contracts using the ASC 606 framework and company policy for revenue recognition.
 



 • Review and approve revenue arrangements for allocations, concessions, and similar items to ensure accurate revenue recognition in compliance with ASC 606\.
 



 • Perform the month\-end revenue close process, including revenue\-related account reconciliations and journal entries for revenue, deferred revenue, and unbilled receivables.
 



 • Perform quarterly CECL aging analysis to ensure consistent application of ASC 326, and partner with the AR \& Collections Lead to develop and report key AR metrics for management reporting.
 



 • Work closely with the AR team to resolve complex AR and collections issues.
 



 • Perform regular month\-end close flux analysis, identifying and explaining significant variances in revenue and accounts receivable balances to support financial integrity and management decision\-making.
 



 • Perform and maintain the annual SSP (standalone selling price) analysis, including management of the item master and fair value records.
 



 • Collaborate cross\-functionally with GTM, Deal Desk, and AR teams to resolve issues.
 



 • Support revenue accounting system initiatives, including implementation, testing, and optimization.
 



 • Prepare audit schedules and assist with coordination of the year\-end audit with external auditors. • Maintain the highest documentation standards.
 



 • Partner with FP\&A to provide inputs for revenue forecasts as needed.
 



 • Prepare detailed revenue packages for management and the audit committee/Board as requested.
 



 • Participate in special projects as they arise.
 



  





 What You Need
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
 



 • Strong understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
 



 • 7\+ years of experience in revenue accounting, and full\-cycle accounts receivable, ideally for SaaS companies.
 



 • Knowledge of US GAAP revenue accounting, specifically revenue from customer contracts (ASC 606\), is required.
 



 • Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage effectively through ambiguity and complexity.
 



 • Consistently meets deadlines, prioritizes appropriately, and remains flexible.
 



 • Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace applications.
 



 • Highly motivated, energetic self\-starter and strategic thinker.
 



 • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build relationships within and outside the Finance team.
 



 • Experience with NetSuite ERP, NetSuite ARM, and Salesforce is required.
 



  





 Things That Make a Difference
 



 ● Familiarity with US sales tax regulations and requirements.
 



 ● Proven expertise managing full\-cycle accounts receivable processes.
 



 ● Knowledge of Order Processing.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience navigating customer procurement portals, including Coupa and Ariba.

* Experience reviewing and interpreting commercial credit agreements and related servicing documentation.

* work experience, training, military experience, education

**Job Expectations:**

* Lead issue resolution requiring coordination among Deal Administration, Quality Control, Collateral, Sales, Legal, Risk, Control, Technology, Finance, and other Operations teams.

* Support workload prioritization during high\-volume periods, complex transaction events, staffing gaps, or critical deadlines.
* Review procedures, job aids, training materials, and control documentation for operational accuracy and completeness.

title: Senior Accountant, Statutory Reporting
description:
**The opportunity**
 Unity’s Accounting team is looking for a highly skilled Senior Accountant to be an integral part of our dynamic, global finance organization. In this role, you will serve as the crucial gatekeeper for our Indian entity's financial compliance, bridging our global US GAAP ledger with local regulatory requirements. You will step into a tech\-forward, high\-impact environment where you will own end\-to\-end Ind AS statutory reporting, drive process engineering, and leverage modern technology to streamline GAAP\-to\-GAAP adjustments. If you are a problem\-solver who thrives at the intersection of local accounting compliance, global collaboration, and AI\-driven automation, you will find an exciting home with our team.
   

  

 You will have an immediate impact by tightening our local compliance footprint and ensuring our Indian statutory reporting is bulletproof. Working closely under the guidance of your Singapore\-based manager, you will serve as the localized expert who reviews global transactions, flags compliance issues early, and collaborates regionally on how to resolve them.
   

  

 At Unity, you’ll make a difference. In a collaborative, fast paced environment, we’re redefining development, solving hard problems, and enabling the success of our community. Inclusion at Unity is driven by one overarching framework: Empathy, Respect, and Opportunity.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* India Statutory Reporting: Drive end\-to\-end statutory financial reporting for the India entity in strict compliance with Ind AS and Schedule III of the Companies Act.
* GAAP Review \& Alignment: On a regular basis, thoroughly review global US GAAP transactions posted by other teams to understand their nature, and calculate, prepare, and post the necessary adjustments to align the financial numbers with Ind AS for local statutory purposes.
* Direct Manager Collaboration: Proactively identify and discuss any compliance issues, structural variances, or transaction anomalies with your direct manager, collaboratively developing practical solutions to resolve them.
* Tech\-Driven Problem Solving: Actively identify variances between US GAAP and Ind AS, trace them to their root cause, and resolve them by reviewing operational processes, system enhancement, and utilizing AI tools or automation to track and reconcile cross\-border data.


**What We're Looking For**
* Ind AS \& Schedule III Financial Preparation: Proven ability to independently prepare a complete set of financial statements (Balance Sheet, P\&L, Cash Flow, and Notes) in strict compliance with Ind AS and Schedule III of the Indian Companies Act, 2013\.
* US GAAP to Ind AS Reconciliation: Technical capability to analyze transactions recorded under US GAAP, map the ledger differences, and post accurate Ind AS adjustment entries.
* CARO \& Statutory Audit Management: Experience drafting audit schedules and directly addressing queries for Companies Auditor’s Report Order (CARO) clauses, including fixed assets and related\-party transaction testing.
* ERP Systems Ledger Management: Practical proficiency in executing multi\-currency reconciliations, adjusting sub\-ledgers, and managing parallel ledger configurations in ERPs


**You might also have**
* Adept at handling shifting priorities and meeting deadlines
* Proactive and eager to learn and try new things
* Ability to work with team members spread across geographies
* Experience with Workday Financials will be a plus

title: Credit Portfolio Consultant
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Credit Portfolio Consultant.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Participate in less complex consulting services and identify opportunity for providing credit and portfolio expertise
* Identify and assess credit performance, as well as potential and emerging risks, and partnering on credit and portfolio strategies within the scope of responsibilities
* Review and analyze credit performance or credit portfolio that require research, evaluation, and selection of alternatives, and exercise independent judgment to guide medium risk deliverables
* Present recommendations for resolving more complex situations and exercise independent judgment while developing expertise in credit consulting services
* Collaborate and consult with functional colleagues, internal partners, and stakeholders, including internal or external customers
* Work with business partners, provide analytic solutions, and develop strategies to support or negate change recommendations


****Required Qualifications:****
* 4\+ years of Credit Portfolio Consulting experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


****Desired Qualifications:****
* MBA (Finance /Banking), Cost and Management Accountancy, Chartered Accountancy or post\- graduation in Economics.
* 4\+ years of overall commercial credit experience across diversified asset classes (includes corporate entities and real estate asset class).
* Sound knowledge on financial statements for various industries with ability to ascertain trends, ratios and call out key risks when compared to benchmarks (historical and industry performance).
* Strong communication skills
* Ability to read, comprehend and synthesize data regarding borrower performance / market related information from multiple sources.
* Able to proactively identify potential issues or red flags within the control environment and escalate concerns in a timely manner.
* Demonstrates the ability to understand issues end\-to\-end and accurately articulate problems, root causes, and impacts to Operations teams and business stakeholder
* Hands\-on experience or working knowledge of platforms such as AFS, Loan IQ, LUCAS, CHOICE, Collateral360, nCino, and ICMP is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of data review, remediation, and reconciliation within Commercial with rigorous data investigations conducted to identify, analyze, and resolve discrepancies.
* In\-depth understanding of systems of origin within Commercial Banking, specifically MCSI and Capital Finance, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and alignment across reporting and downstream processes.
* Strong analytical approach with critical interpretation of regulatory instructions (FR Y\-14Q/M) and translated into clearly defined data validation and review requirements, supported by solid understanding of credit products and internal credit policies.
* Robust understanding of risk rating frameworks and governance processes with structured analysis performed to ensure accurate risk classification and adherence to established control and compliance expectations.
* Understands audit trail concepts and maintains appropriate documentation and evidence to support internal and external audits, including timely and accurate responses to audit requests.
* Operates with a strong "One Team" philosophy, collaborating effectively across functions and contributing positively to shared objectives.
* Intermediary to advanced excel skills would be a plus.


****Job Expectations:****
* The role involves supporting the Credit Underwriting and Portfolio Monitoring processes to ensure adherence to applicable credit policies and procedures.
* This team will provide secondary credit review and detective control of credit policies and associated process\-related procedures for the line of business loan portfolio.
* The role also involves seeking opportunities to recommend process improvement in support of the risk management priorities of the bank.
* Perform reviews of credit reports prepared by credit underwriting teams and support oversight of related loan data.
* Review and validate the accuracy in financial analysis for commercial loans
* Summarize errors and outline areas of risk from reviewing the credit underwriting details.
* Accurately identify applicable credit policy exceptions by reviewing the credit documents.
* Surface and escalate risk often identified from inadequate or failed processes, and error trends.
* Clarify and credibly challenges in case of ambiguity or deviation to the policy and procedures.
* Document and synthesize findings based on above mentioned conclusions into a report presented to credit underwriting team.
* As needed, participate and provide SME expertise for business initiatives.
* Understand the feedback received from the senior reviewers in the team and implement the same in their day\-to\-day work.
* Quality\-check the work performed by junior team members and provide appropriate feedback on the same
* Basic understanding of governance, risk management, and control assessment concepts , and applies this knowledge in day\-to\-day execution.


**Required AI Skills and Competencies**
**As part of Wells Fargo's commitment to innovation and responsible AI adoption, all roles require foundational AI literacy. This includes:**
* Understanding and Application of AI Tools: Ability to leverage AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Tachyon, Agentspace) for routine tasks such as summarizing information, drafting content, and analyzing data, while maintaining human oversight.
* Critical Thinking: Ability to interpret AI outputs, validate insights, and make informed business decisions.
* Responsible AI Use: Awareness of ethical considerations, data privacy, and compliance when using AI solutions.
* Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Commitment to upskilling and staying current with emerging technologies.

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This position will lead the technical design, deployment, and operational management of QAD's Finance AI agents. The role bridges finance operations, data engineering, and AI systems to build secure, high\-performing, and auditable agent\-assisted workflows that optimize finance processes.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Data Foundation \& Semantic Layer
* Define and own the context tables (business glossary, entity definitions, metric hierarchies) that ground AI agents in QAD's financial reality.
* Build and maintain the semantic layer — the translation between raw Google Cloud BigQuery datasets and the financial concepts agents reason over
* Partner with the data engineering team and other functions on dbt model governance and Fivetran pipeline integrity
* Agent Architecture \& Process Design
* Determine the build methodology for process agents — frameworks, orchestration patterns, tool use conventions, handoff protocols between agents
* Sequence the agent build roadmap.
* Design the human\-in\-the\-loop thresholds — when an agent escalates vs. executes autonomously
* Own the technical architecture decisions: LLM selection, retrieval strategy, memory design, context window management
* Agent Operations \& Lifecycle Management
* Run the agent registry — versioning, deployment, deprecation, and change control for all live agents
* Manage agent performance over time: drift detection, accuracy degradation, prompt updates as business rules change
* Own the incident response protocol when an agent produces an incorrect output or takes an unintended action
* Coordinate agent updates when underlying data schemas, business logic, or finance policies change
* Visibility \& Monitoring Platform
* Build or procure a Finance AI Control Center — a dashboard giving real\-time visibility into which agents are running, what they've done, error rates, and escalation queues
* Define and track agent KPIs: task completion rate, exception rate, cycle time vs. manual baseline, cost per transaction
* Create an audit log for every agent action — who initiated it, what data was touched, what output was produced
* Report agent health and ROI to management on a regular cadence
* AI Risk Management \& Internal Controls
* Design and own the internal control framework for AI in Finance
* Define approval hierarchies: what an agent can do autonomously vs. what requires human sign\-off (e.g., any journal entry over $X requires controller review)
* Partner with infosec on data access controls
* Finance Organization Training \& Change Management
* Design and deliver the Finance AI literacy curriculum — from foundational concepts to role\-specific agent interaction training
* Build the change management playbook for the transition: how teams move from manual processes to agent\-assisted workflows
* Create and maintain agent user guides — what each agent does, its limitations, how to override it, and how to report issues
* Work with Finance leaders to embed AI fluency into their team cultures
* Process Reengineering
* Lead the Finance process rewrite initiative
* Identify which steps in each process are agent\-executable vs. requiring judgment, and draw those boundaries explicitly
* Ensure redesigned processes still satisfy internal control requirements and auditability standards
* Feed process redesign outputs back into agent specifications and the semantic layer


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 8 years of experience. Hands\-on experience building and managing LLM\-based agents in production environments. Background spanning finance operations, data engineering, and AI/ML systems.
* Computer skills: BigQuery, dbt, Fivetran, SQL, Python, LLM orchestration frameworks, data pipeline management.
* Deep understanding of financial controls, finance operational process flows, and audit requirements. Expertise in LLM \& Agentic Architecture, and Change Management \& Training
* Background spanning finance operations \+ data engineering \+ AI/ML systems
* Has built or managed LLM\-based agents in a production environment, not just POCs
* Understands financial controls, finance operational process flows and audit requirements — not just a technologist
* Strong communicator who can bridge your finance leads and the technical implementation tea


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.

title: Manager- Finance FP&A
description:
This is a core Financial Planning \& Analysis role housed within the CEO Office \& Strategy team. You will own the planning, forecasting, performance\-reporting and profitability agenda for the business, and act as the financial conscience in leadership discussions – the person who can say, with evidence, what the numbers mean and what should be done about them.
   

  

 The role is deliberately hands\-on and full\-stack. You will build the models, write the queries, design the dashboards, close the variance analysis and then present the story to the CEO and leadership team. It combines classic FP\&A depth with modern data tooling, and it requires someone who is as comfortable in a DAX measure and a SQL join as in a P\&L, a cash flow and a month\-end close.
   

  

 Given the exposure to confidential financial information and the technical accounting judgement involved, a qualified Chartered Accountant is a mandatory requirement for this position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Budgeting, Forecasting \& Planning**
* Own the annual operating plan and budget end to end – timelines, templates, assumption sets, bottom\-up build\-up with function heads, consolidation, review cycles and final leadership sign\-off.
* Run the rolling forecast process (monthly / quarterly) covering revenue, gross margin, operating cost, EBITDA, working capital and cash, with clear documentation of assumptions and bridges to the prior view.
* Build and maintain driver\-based financial models that link operational volumes and activity to financial outcomes, rather than growing lines by a percentage.
* Prepare long\-range plans and multi\-year business projections to support strategic, capacity and investment decisions.
* Run scenario, sensitivity and what\-if analyses (best / base / downside) and quantify the financial impact of strategic options for leadership.
* Performance Reporting, Variance \& Business Partnering
* Own the monthly MIS and management reporting pack – P\&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPI dashboards and management commentary – delivered accurately and on the committed calendar.
* Perform detailed budget\-versus\-actual and forecast\-versus\-actual variance analysis; explain movements by driver (volume, price, mix, cost, phasing) and not merely by line item.
* Act as finance business partner to sales, operations, delivery and support functions – challenge spend, validate business cases and help function heads manage to plan.
* Prepare material for monthly and quarterly business reviews, board packs, investor updates and lender or auditor requirements.
* Maintain an early\-warning view on performance risks and opportunities, and drive corrective action with the relevant owners.
* Profitability, Cost \& Cash
* Analyse profitability at every meaningful cut – project, product, customer, channel, region, service line – and identify where value is being created and destroyed.
* Build and refine unit economics, contribution margin and cost\-to\-serve models; support pricing, discounting, bidding and make\-versus\-buy decisions with quantified analysis.
* Drive cost control and efficiency initiatives: opex and overhead analysis, vendor and category spend review, headcount and manpower cost planning, and tracking of savings actually realised.
* Monitor working capital – receivables, payables, inventory and advances – and support cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning.
* Evaluate capital expenditure proposals and new investments using NPV, IRR, payback and ROCE; track post\-implementation performance against the approved case.
* Accounting Workflows, Close \& Controls
* Work closely with the accounts and controllership team through the month\-end and year\-end close – accruals, provisions, cut\-off, cost allocations and revenue recognition – to ensure reported numbers are complete and correct.
* Apply a strong working understanding of end\-to\-end accounting workflows (order to cash, procure to pay, record to report, fixed assets, payroll) when interpreting, reconciling and challenging data.
* Reconcile management reporting to the statutory books and clearly explain the bridge between the two.
* Ensure reporting and analysis respect applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IFRS as relevant), internal control requirements and audit expectations.
* Support statutory audit, internal audit, tax and compliance requirements with analysis, schedules and explanations as required.
* Strategy \& CEO Office Support
* Convert open\-ended questions from the CEO and leadership into structured analyses with clear, defensible recommendations.
* Prepare business cases, decision notes and financial evaluations for new initiatives, markets, partnerships and organic or inorganic growth opportunities.
* Track strategic priorities and enterprise KPIs across functions, flag deviations early and drive closure with business owners.


**Candidate RequirementsQualifications – Mandatory**
* Essential: Chartered Accountant (CA) – qualified and in good standing. This is a non\-negotiable requirement; applications without CA qualification will not be considered.
* Essential: Minimum 5 years of post\-qualification experience in FP\&A, business finance, management reporting, controllership or a CEO / MD office finance role.


**Technical Skills**
* Essential: Full\-cycle FP\&A ownership – budgeting, rolling forecasting, variance analysis, MIS, profitability analysis and driver\-based financial modelling.
* Essential: Strong command of accounting standards, month\-end close processes and the link between management and statutory reporting.
* Essential: Practical understanding of relational data structures, keys, joins and granularity
* Essential: Confident presentation skills in PowerPoint for board, investor and leadership audiences.
* Preferred: Hands\-on experience with Oracle (NetSuite) ERP
* Preferred: Experience in a multi\-entity, multi\-currency or multi\-geography reporting environment.


**Behavioural Attributes**
* High ownership – takes a problem from question to answer to action with limited direction.
* Rigorous attention to detail; a number presented to leadership must be right and must be defensible.
* Commercial mindset – interprets numbers in terms of business decisions, not just accounting outcomes.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain financial analysis to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Able to influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively, without direct authority.
* Absolute discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial and business information.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and short turnaround requests.


**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**
* The annual budget and rolling forecast run on a clear calendar, with assumptions documented and forecast accuracy improving cycle over cycle.
* There is visibility on cost leaks and a clear action plan to address those
* The monthly MIS closes on time, reconciles to the books and is explained by driver rather than by line item.
* Leadership reviews run on a single, automated and trusted set of dashboards instead of competing spreadsheets.
* Profitability by project, customer and service line is visible, understood and actively managed.
* Recurring manual reporting effort is materially reduced through better data models and automation.
