title: Head of Treasury
description:
Head – Treasury
 



  





 Job Purpose
 



 The Head – Treasury will own the company's overall treasury strategy, including funds mobilisation from domestic and international debt markets, investment of surplus liquidity, and management of interest rate, currency, and liquidity risk.
 



 The role is accountable for optimising the cost of funds, ensuring robust liquidity and ALM management, maintaining full regulatory compliance, and building deep relationships with banks, mutual funds, insurance companies, rating agencies, and other market participants.
 



 The role leads the entire Treasury function and is a key member of the Finance leadership team, working closely with the CFO on funding strategy, capital structure, and Board/ALCO reporting.
 



 Other Quantitative / Qualitative Parameters \- Financial
 


* Cost of Borrowing (COB)
* Cost of Funds (COF)
* Borrowing mix
* Investor diversification
* LCR/ALM support
* Overall Treasury P\&L impact



 Research
 


* Interest rate outlook
* Market dynamics
* Peer/competitor benchmarking



 External Agencies
 


* Banks
* Mutual Funds
* Insurance Companies
* Corporates
* Financial Institutions/DFIs
* Exchanges
* Depositories
* Rating Agencies
* Trustees



 Job Context \& Major Challenges
 



 Treasury at Bajaj Auto Credit Limited is responsible for mobilising and deploying funds at optimal cost, managing asset\-liability risk, maintaining regulatory liquidity buffers (LCR), hedging interest rate and currency exposure, and sustaining relationships with a broad base of lenders and investors, all while supporting the growth of the company's lending book.
 



 The Head – Treasury owns this mandate end\-to\-end: setting the borrowing strategy in consultation with the CFO, leading negotiation and closure of funding transactions across NCDs, CPs, bank lines, and ECBs, and building a resilient, diversified funding base that can flex with business growth.
 



 The role also carries full accountability for the team's output, for regulatory and audit compliance, and for representing Treasury at ALCO, RMC, and Board levels.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Funding Strategy and Market Execution
* Own the overall borrowing strategy and calendar, in consultation with the CFO.
* Mobilise funds through private placement/public issue of NCDs and CPs, and through bank lines.
* Raise External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs) from overseas lenders and DFIs, maintaining strong global banking relationships.
* Time market entry to minimise cost of borrowing; track interest rate movements, credit spreads, and investor appetite.
* Decide and adjust the borrowing mix (short vs. long tenor, bank vs. market) to meet cost and diversification objectives.



 Relationship Management and Investor Diversification
 


* Build and sustain senior\-level relationships with banks, mutual funds, insurance companies, corporates, FIs, and international lenders.
* Continuously widen and deepen the investor base across domestic and international markets.
* Manage the rating agency relationship and credit rating review process.



 Liquidity and Investment Management
 


* Direct investment of surplus funds in G\-Secs, T\-Bills, and other approved securities to meet LCR requirements.
* Work with the ALM/Cashflow teams to plan liquidity, minimise negative carry, and optimise returns on surplus funds.



 Risk Management and Hedging
 


* Own the interest rate and currency hedging strategy (OIS, IRS, futures, and other derivatives) for the borrowing book.
* Ensure MTM, valuation, and reporting of the debt and investment portfolio are accurate and timely.
* Build and maintain a robust risk management framework covering credit, market, and liquidity risk.



 Team Leadership and Operations
 


* Lead, mentor, and manage the Treasury team (Debt Markets, Investments, Treasury Operations).
* Oversee end\-to\-end execution, settlement, and documentation of all borrowing and investment transactions per SOPs.
* Drive automation and digitisation of Treasury systems and processes.



 Compliance and Governance
 


* Ensure full compliance with RBI, SEBI, FEMA, NHB, and FIMMDA guidelines applicable to Treasury operations.
* Ensure Treasury is fully prepared for statutory, internal, and concurrent audits.
* Present funding, investment, and risk positions to ALCO, RMC, the Board, and senior management.
* Provide accurate data for central MIS (COB, COF, budgets, projections).



 Critical Skill Sets
 


* Strong background in financial modelling and analysis.
* Deep expertise in domestic and international debt capital markets.
* Strong track record reading and acting on interest rate and market movements.
* Demonstrated leadership managing a mid\-to\-large treasury/finance team.
* Excellent negotiation and stakeholder\-influencing skills, including at CXO/Board level.
* Strong existing network across banks, DFIs, mutual funds, and rating agencies.



 Major Challenges in the Role
 


* Securing funds at optimal cost in volatile domestic and global markets.
* Balancing currency, interest rate, and liquidity risk across a growing book.
* Reading market direction early enough to act on it.
* Structuring innovative funding solutions (securitisation, structured debt, bond arbitrage) where standard instruments fall short.
* Continuously diversifying the investor base to avoid concentration risk.
* Staying ahead of evolving regulatory requirements across RBI, SEBI, and FEMA.



 Education \& Experience
 


* MBA (Finance), CA, CFA, or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* 10–13 years of relevant experience in corporate treasury, debt capital markets, or NBFC/banking treasury.
* At least 5\+ years in a leadership role managing borrowings, investments, ECBs, and full treasury operations.
* Prior experience presenting to ALCO/Board\-level forums preferred.



 Key Result Areas (KRAs)
 


* Funds Mobilisation from Domestic \& International Markets
* Mobilise funds via NCDs/CPs and bank lines.
* Raise ECBs in compliance with RBI/FEMA.
* Monitor fund inflows/outflows against business demand.
* Plan rollovers ahead of redemptions.
* Optimise short/long\-term and bank/market mix.
* Lead emergency fund mobilisation when required.



 Liquidity \& Investment Management
 


* Set investment strategy for G\-Secs/T\-Bills/approved securities to meet LCR.
* Manage surplus liquidity to minimise negative carry.
* Coordinate with ALM/Cashflow teams.
* Drive returns through efficient fund deployment.



 Relationship Management \& Investor Diversification
 


* Maintain senior relationships across banks, MFs, insurers, corporates, FIs, and DFIs.
* Grow and diversify the investor base.
* Manage rating agency engagement.
* Present funding propositions to CFOs/Treasury Heads/CIOs of counterparties.
* Structure innovative funding deals where useful.



 Risk Management \& Hedging
 


* Hedge interest rate risk via OIS/IRS/futures.
* Hedge FX exposure on foreign borrowings.
* Build and maintain the risk management framework.
* Ensure accurate MTM/valuation.
* Present risk positions to ALCO/RMC/Board.



 Execution \& Team Leadership
 


* Ensure clean end\-to\-end execution and settlement of all deals per SOP.
* Lead and develop the Treasury team.
* Drive automation/digitisation of Treasury systems.
* Ensure documentation and disclosures meet statutory norms.



 Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure adherence to RBI/SEBI/NHB/FEMA requirements.
* Keep Treasury audit\-ready (statutory, internal, concurrent).
* Maintain governance to avoid penalties/reputational risk.
* Ensure accurate, timely regulator reporting.



 MIS, Reporting \& Market Intelligence
 


* Produce MIS on borrowings, investments, COB/COF, and benchmarks.
* Present Treasury updates at management/ALCO/Board reviews.
* Track domestic/global market developments and share insights with leadership.

MS teams work inside a SOC 1 Type II control environment across break analysis \& resolution, daily NAV production, trade affirmation using industry\-standard platforms such as CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, and DTCC ALERT. As an intern on this team, you'll get first\-hand exposure to how a fund's operations actually run behind the scenes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Reconciliation Support: assist in matching internal transaction records against custodian, broker, and bank statements, and help log discrepancies for the team to investigate.
* Data Entry \& Validation: help record investor inflows, redemptions, corporate actions, and trade bookings accurately into the core portfolio accounting system (Enfusion).
* Trade Support: observe and support daily trade affirmation workflows across platforms including CTM, NYFIX, and Traiana.
* NAV \& Reporting: shadow the daily NAV process \& monthly trial balance reconciliation and help prepare operational reports.
* Records and reports the status of daily and monthly operational delivery.


**What You'll Gain**
* Direct, hands\-on exposure to how a real fund's middle and back office runs on a daily market cycle.
* Training on Enfusion and industry\-standard platforms — CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, DTCC ALERT, and EMIR reporting tools.
* Mentorship from experienced fund operations professionals across reconciliation, NAV accounting, and trade lifecycle management.
* A front\-row seat to how a SOC 1 Type II controlled operating environment is run in practice.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, Business Management, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications (Bonus): Progress toward CFA Level I, NISM, or another relevant local market certification is a plus, though not required.


**Hard Skills**
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills — comfortable with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and handling large data sets without errors.
* Basic understanding of financial statements, general ledger accounting, and how corporate actions (e.g., stock splits, dividends) affect fund valuations.
* Asset Classes: Intermediate understanding of fixed income and equity investments and a basic knowledge of alternative security types
* Strong accounting and/or finance skills.
* Familiarity with core operational concepts — how NAV is calculated daily, and the trade settlement lifecycle (e.g., clearing, custodian communication, T\+1 settlement).


**Soft Skills**
* Hyper\-attention to detail — accuracy matters; a single misplaced decimal or swapped account number can cause real compliance and financial issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication for presenting findings and handling internal or client queries.
* Process orientation — able to follow structured SOPs precisely while spotting opportunities to improve them.
* Time management under pressure — comfortable working to firm daily market cut\-off times.
* A proactive, eager\-to\-learn attitude toward new financial software and workflows.

 • Ensure documentation integrity and audit\-ready reconciliations aligned with global policy.

 • Enforce SOX controls, journal approval discipline, evidence standards, and documentation requirements.
   

  

 • Ensure teams are audit\-ready at all times, supporting internal/external audits with transparency and zero repeat findings.
   

  

 • Maintain compliance with IFRS/US GAAP, NIQ policies, and global control frameworks.

 • Act as the operational partner to Entity/Cluster Controllers, Close Managers, and Finance stakeholders.

 • Manage escalations proactively and professionally, ensuring confidence in financial outcomes.

title: Manager / Assistant Vice President (AVP)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Investment Banking professional to join our Sell\-Side Investment Banking team, focused on helping companies raise capital and prepare for their next stage of growth.
   

  

 The role will primarily involve working with IPO\-bound, pre\-IPO and high\-growth companies on fundraising, capital structuring, investor positioning and transaction execution.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in investment banking, equity fundraising, IPO/pre\-IPO transactions, corporate finance, valuation and client acquisition, along with the ability to independently manage relationships with promoters, founders, investors and other transaction stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Origination \& Client Acquisition
* Identify and develop relationships with companies that are potential pre\-IPO or IPO candidates.
* Source new mandates through promoter/founder relationships, professional networks, intermediaries and industry relationships.
* Develop a strong pipeline of potential fundraising and IPO mandates.
* Understand the company’s business, capital requirements, growth plans and fundraising objectives.
* Pitch and present investment banking solutions to promoters, founders and senior management.
* Fundraising \& Transaction Execution
* Lead and support equity fundraising transactions, including pre\-IPO/private placements and other structured equity transactions.
* Work with companies to determine appropriate fundraising size, valuation, transaction structure and investor positioning.
* Coordinate the complete transaction process from mandate acquisition through successful closure.
* Prepare transaction timelines, investor lists, deal structures and execution plans.
* Coordinate with legal, secretarial, accounting, merchant banking, due\-diligence and other professional advisors.
* IPO \& Pre\-IPO Advisory
* Evaluate companies for IPO readiness and identify gaps that need to be addressed before listing.
* Assist companies in developing an appropriate roadmap from private/pre\-IPO stage to IPO.
* Work closely with management on business positioning, equity story and investor communication.
* Support preparation of investor presentations, information memoranda, financial analysis and other transaction\-related materials.
* Assist in valuation analysis and benchmarking against listed and comparable companies.
* Investor \& Institutional Relationships
* Develop and maintain relationships with HNI, family office, institutional and strategic investors.
* Build and maintain an investor database across sectors.
* Match suitable companies and transactions with relevant investors.
* Coordinate investor meetings, management presentations, conference calls and due\-diligence discussions.
* Understand investor requirements and communicate transaction opportunities effectively.
* Financial Analysis \& Valuation
* Build and review financial models, projections and valuation analyses.
* Conduct comparable\-company, precedent\-transaction and other relevant valuation analyses.
* Analyse financial statements, business performance, growth prospects and key operating metrics.
* Assist management in understanding valuation expectations and capital\-market positioning.
* Deal Management
* Take ownership of assigned mandates and ensure timely execution.
* Manage multiple transactions simultaneously and maintain transaction trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Identify transaction risks, bottlenecks and execution issues and proactively resolve them.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality and transaction discipline.


 Business Development Expectations
   

  

 For the Manager/AVP level, this is not intended to be a purely execution\-oriented role.
   

  

**The Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Build a meaningful company/promoter pipeline.
* Develop independent relationships with founders, promoters and senior management.
* Generate new investment\-banking mandates.
* Convert opportunities into signed mandates and successfully executed transactions.
* Build long\-term relationships with companies beyond a single fundraising transaction.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong understanding of Investment Banking and Sell\-Side transactions.
* Experience in equity fundraising, pre\-IPO, IPO or corporate finance.
* Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
* Excellent understanding of financial statements and capital structures.
* Strong business\-development and relationship\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to interact confidently with promoters, CXOs, investors and senior stakeholders.
* Strong transaction\-management and execution capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a high\-growth, entrepreneurial environment.


**Preferred Background**
 Candidates from the following backgrounds would be relevant:
   

  

* Investment Banking
* CFA (Mandatory)
* Equity Capital Markets
* Merchant Banking
* Corporate Finance
* M\&A / Transaction Advisory
* Private Equity / Venture Capital with strong transaction exposure
* Big 4 Transaction Advisory / Deals
* Securities / Capital Markets


 Experience specifically involving IPO, pre\-IPO or equity fundraising transactions will be an advantage.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to build and manage a strong pipeline of IPO\-bound and pre\-IPO companies, originate high\-quality mandates, execute fundraising transactions efficiently and develop long\-term relationships with promoters and investors.
   

  

 In short: Originate → Advise → Structure → Raise Capital → Execute → Build Long\-Term Client Relationships.

description:
At Ecolab, you can help take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, delivering critical insights and innovative solutions to help our customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments. With our worldwide reach and ambitious growth plans, you will have the opportunity to own your future and impact what matters. Are you ready to make an impact?
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* You will join a growth company offering a competitive salary and benefits.
* The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.
* The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best.

**Role Summary**
 The Analytics Lead is a business\-outcomes focused leader who sits at the intersection of business, analytics, and data science. This role is responsible for translating ambiguous business questions from business stakeholders into clear, actionable analytical projects. Those projects will allow your team to deliver insights that drive different and more profitable decisions across Ecolab.
   

  

 This individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day\-to\-day may include rapidly prototyping, refining solutions with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.
   

  

 Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, and scalable data solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into data\-driven solutions
+ Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
+ Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value


* Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools
+ Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
+ Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools.
+ Iterate based on feedback to refine solutions.

* Apply the appropriate analytical approach
+ Work with stakeholders to determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
+ Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).

* Perform data transformation and analysis
+ Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage Databricks or Python to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.

* Design meaningful metrics and outputs
+ Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
+ Ensure outputs are interpretable and relevant to business needs.

* Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions
+ Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
+ Partner cross\-functionally to scale solutions into production

* Operate flexibly between guiding team and execution
+ Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
+ Contribute hands\-on development when needed in resource\-constrained environments

* Drive insight\-led decision\-making
+ Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
+ Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
* Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
* Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
* Strong problem\-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Databricks or Python for data transformation and modeling
* Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using Python.
* Experience with AI\-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
* Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
* Exposure to product\-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
* Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
* Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. title: Associate, Production Finance - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
   

  

 Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.
   

  

 If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.
   

  

 This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.
   

  

 You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Partner with Productions**
* Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.
* Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.
* Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.


**Drive Financial Excellence**
* Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.
* Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.
* Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.
* Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.
* Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.


**Deliver Meaningful Insights**
* Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.
* Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.
* Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.


**Strengthen Financial Operations**
* Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.
* Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.
* Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.
   

  

**You'll Be Successful In This Role If You Have**
* 7\+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.
* Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.
* Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.
* Excellent financial analysis and problem\-solving skills with strong business judgment.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You thrive in fast\-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.
* You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.
* You balance analytical thinking with practical decision\-making.
* You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.
* You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.


 Why Netflix?
   

  

 At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.
   

  

 You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world\-class stories are produced.
   

  

 If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

 foresight using established business frameworks to influence Roche’s global product pipeline and commercial launch strategies.
   

  

 The Opportunity

**Qualifications \& Skills**

 Education

title: Capital Markets Associate - Real Estate
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–8 years, with hands\-on US commercial real estate debt experience required
   

  

**Working hours:** 
 Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time
   

  

**Compensation:** 
 ₹300,000–470,000/month, based on depth of direct US CRE debt experience
   

  

**Start:** 
 Immediate or within 30 days
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Sanctuary is building something most real estate companies aren't even trying to build: wellness\-focused, nature\-integrated home communities across the Texas Hill Country, designed around the idea that where you live should make you healthier, calmer, and more connected. And now we're scaling the capital engine behind it.
   

  

 This is a company in build mode. You'd be joining early enough to shape how we finance growth for years to come, not stepping into a process that's already set in stone.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring an Associate to structure and execute debt for our US real estate portfolio \- construction, bridge, and permanent financing across multifamily, commercial, and ground\-up development. This is not a corporate credit, project finance, or loan servicing role: every transaction you'll work on is tied to a specific US property, and you'll be underwriting, structuring, and negotiating real loans against real collateral, not modeling hypotheticals.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Capital Lead and work closely with our CEO to determine how we finance and scale our real estate pipeline.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Deal structuring \& execution: Underwrite and structure construction, bridge, and mezzanine financing for specific US assets. Take term sheets apart and put them back together to win on pricing, leverage, and flexibility.
* Capital modeling: Build the models that drive real decisions — DSCR, LTV, LTC, IRR, debt yield, stress\-tested against rate moves, lease\-up delays, cost overruns.
* Capital stack strategy: Recommend how we fund specific projects, balancing cost of capital against risk and timeline.
* Lender relations \& syndication: Be a real point of contact for US lenders and institutional capital partners. Run the diligence process and drive facilities to close.
* Portfolio surveillance: Own the debt maturity ladder across the portfolio and keep every DSCR, LTV, and LTC covenant in view before it becomes a problem.


**What You Bring**
* 3–8 years in real estate capital markets, real estate private equity, CRE lending, or real estate investment banking.
* A specific US commercial real estate deal you can walk us through in detail, the property, the structure, the numbers you calculated, and why.
* Excel and Google sheets mastery, including built debt waterfalls; VBA or Power Query is a strong plus.
* Real working knowledge of US credit agreements, loan documentation, and institutional underwriting standards for real estate.
* The ability to turn dense underwriting into a memo an executive can act on in five minutes.
* Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time.


**Not the right fit if:** 
 your background is loan servicing, reconciliation, back\-office operations, or ratings/research without direct property\-level underwriting. We'd rather point you toward a role that's a better match than waste your time or ours.
   

  

**Why join now**
* Real stakes, real speed. You're not modeling hypotheticals \- you're advising directly on how we move millions of dollars to build communities that are already going up.
* A seat at the table. Direct exposure to senior leadership and the institutional lenders who fund our growth.
* Build the function, not just the deals. We don't have a Senior Capital Markets hire yet \- you'd be the first person to lay the groundwork for how this function works at Sanctuary.
* Total ownership. We hand you real runway to improve how we underwrite and close, not a script to follow.
* Mission you can feel. You're financing homes designed to make people's lives measurably better \-v not another spec subdivision.

title: Sr. Analyst, Product Project Management (PET)
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The GIC Supply Chain team manages planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics to meet market needs, optimize operations, and enable the efficient movement of goods from production to delivery.
   

  

 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The Senior Analyst, Product Project Management ensures the availability and effective management of ingredients and packaging materials for US\-based product and business initiatives. Responsibilities include planning\-system setup, risk and waste assessment, mitigation, and project execution.
   

  

 Partners with Project Planning, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Materials Management, PMO, Marketing, Sales, R\&D, Sourcing, and Manufacturing teams.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

**100% of Time**
**Product Setup \& Commercialization Governance**
* Lead material setup and lifecycle execution through Gate 2, including new items, packaging codes, extensions, and deactivations in SAP and PLM.
* Ensure master\-data accuracy and governance compliance while resolving workflow and system issues with technical and master\-data teams.
* Support mergers, acquisitions, migrations, and commercialization initiatives; serve as SME for SAP, Evolve, PLM, and ServiceNow.


**Raw Material Lifecycle \& Write\-Off Management**
* Drive lifecycle strategy, RMWO forecasting, reconciliation, and risk mitigation to minimize write\-offs and inventory exposure.
* Lead packaging/vendor transitions, material changeovers, and DISCO tie\-out and drawdown plans to reduce obsolescence.
* Partner with Sourcing, Business Operations, and plants on quantities, disposition orders, inventory levels, safety stocks, and operational continuity.


**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary liaison among Commercialization, Sourcing, Business Operations, plants, and Technical teams.
* Provide risk visibility and mitigation recommendations, track milestones, and highlight impacts to launch timelines and financial exposure.
* Communicate metrics and lifecycle health while managing material setup, packaging\-transition, and lifecycle\-risk escalations.


**Reporting, Controls \& Continuous Improvement**
* Maintain dashboards for commercialization cycle times, data accuracy, RMWO performance, and project metrics.
* Improve lifecycle and data\-governance processes through automation, standardization, and CI tools such as Why\-Why, FMEA, Fishbone, and BPIM.
* Develop SOPs and governance standards while identifying cost\-saving opportunities across the inbound and raw\-material network.


**Business Impact \& Financial Stewardship**
* Manage raw\-material budgets and support financial forecasting by reconciling projections with actuals.
* Reduce write\-offs through proactive lifecycle planning and risk mitigation.


**Education – Full\-time graduation from an accredited university (mandatory; this criterion cannot be altered).**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience.


**Specific Job Experience Or Skills Needed**
* Knowledge of Supply Chain, inventory management, total landed cost, and project management.
* Analytical, mathematical, statistical, and critical\-thinking skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, charts/graphs, macros, Solver, queries, and mathematical functions.
* Experience with SAP MM or other ERP systems.
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, meet tight deadlines, and navigate ambiguity.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset with the ability to coach others and influence.
* Proactive, solution\-oriented approach with sound decision\-making ability.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.


 Competencies/Behaviors Required for the Job
   

  

 Workplace and Leadership Competencies
   

  

 Problem solving and decision making; teamwork and collaboration; accountability; customer focus; planning and organizing; enabling technology; innovation.
   

  

 Academic Competencies
   

  

 Math, statistics, and analytical thinking; applied science and technology; Supply Chain fundamentals; reading and writing; business management fundamentals.
   

  

 Personal Effectiveness Competencies
   

  

 Integrity; continuous learning; communication; interpersonal skills; creativity.
   

  

**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

 About Sandvik Coromant: Sandvik Coromant is the world’s leading supplier of tools, tooling solutions, and know\-how to the metalworking industry. Our solutions serve major industries such as automotive, aerospace, and energy. We have 8,000 employees and a global presence in 130 countries. Sandvik Coromant is part of the Sandvik Machining Solutions business area within the Sandvik Group.
   

  

**Overview of the role:**
 The Finance Projects Manager will lead finance transformation and cross\-functional projects to enhance finance processes, reporting, automation, and digital capabilities. The role will drive process improvements across key finance areas, including accounting, reporting, audits, AR/AP, banking, taxation, ERP/SAP, and financial controls, while partnering with Finance, IT, Shared Services, Operations, and Global stakeholders to deliver standardized, efficient, and technology\-enabled finance solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Finance Transformation \& Projects.
* The Finance Projects Manager will lead and support strategic finance transformation initiatives across Sandvik Coromant India.
* The role will be Lead and manage finance transformation initiatives to improve efficiency, standardization, and governance across finance processes.
* Drive end\-to\-end execution of finance projects including planning, implementation, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and successful delivery.
* Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and digitalization within finance operations.
* Support ERP implementation, upgrades, and finance system enhancements in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders.
* Manage cross\-functional finance projects ensuring alignment with business objectives and global standards.


**Process Improvement \& Automation**
* Drive automation initiatives using digital tools, Power BI, AI\-enabled solutions, and workflow automation platforms.
* Improve financial reporting accuracy, speed, and data quality through process optimization.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual activities and improve productivity across finance functions.


**Financial Operations Support**
* Provide project support across key finance functions including:
* Financial Accounting , Accounts Receivable (AR),Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Banking \& Treasury , Taxation (Direct \& Indirect Taxes), Statutory \& Internal Audits, Financial Reporting ,Compliance, Fixed Assets, Budgeting \& Forecasting ,Financial Controls.


**ERP \& Systems**
* Support implementation and optimization of SAP and other Finance ERP systems.
* Coordinate with Global Finance and IT teams on system enhancements and process improvements.
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, training, and deployment of finance solutions.
* Ensure system controls support compliance and reporting requirements.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Develop and enhance management dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization tools.
* Support finance leadership with data analytics, KPI reporting, and business insights.
* Utilize AI\-enabled tools and advanced reporting techniques to improve decision\-making.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with Finance leadership, Shared Services, Operations, HR, IT, and Global Finance teams to successfully deliver finance projects.
* Drive effective communication and change management throughout project execution.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* CA or MBA Finance with 6–10 years of relevant experience in finance, reporting, auditing, accounting, banking, taxation, ERP/SAP, finance transformation, or related areas.
* Knowledge of SAP, ERP platforms, Power BI, Query/AI tools, workflow automation, or digital finance solutions will be an added advantage.
* Hands\-on exposure to finance processes such as Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, General Ledger, Banking, Reporting, Taxation, Audits, Financial Controls, and M\&A support is preferred.
* Ability to manage cross\-functional finance projects from concept to execution, including stakeholder coordination, timelines, risks, testing, training, and implementation.
* Experience working in manufacturing or multinational organizations is preferred.
* Exposure to Shared Services and Global Finance environments is desirable


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of Finance \& Accounting processes, experience in SAP/ERP systems, Financial Reporting, Audits \& Compliance, Taxation and Financial Controls, Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP) \& Banking, Finance Automation (preferred), Project Management and Process Improvement


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, Project and stakeholder management , Effective communication and collaboration, Continuous improvement mindset, Results\-oriented with high accountability, Adaptable and customer\-focused, Ability to influence and drive change

title: Business Intelligence Consultant , AFFS Accounting Onboarding
description:
**Description**
 Do you want to be in the forefront of engineering big data analytical solutions that takes Amazon's Finance Operations Accounting and Analysis (FOAA) Ordering\-Operations models to the next generation? Do you have a solid analytical thinking, metrics driven decision making and want to solve problems with solutions that will meet the growing worldwide need? We are looking for top notch Business Intelligence Engineers to be part of FOAA Ordering\-Operations team to build data and analytics solutions powering Amazon's FOAA org. We perform data modeling, build real time analytical platforms using big data tools and AWS technologies like EMR, SNS, SQS, Lambda, DynamoDB Streams.
   

  

 As a BIE II, you'll work on building analytical solutions that empower Central Accounting, Ordering as well as Transportation Tech teams worldwide. You'll develop both near\-real\-time (NRT) streaming pipelines and batch processing pipelines that deliver critical insights for decision\-making. You'll also build metrics for the Central Accounting, Ordering and for Transportation, while contributing to innovative AI\-powered solutions delivering automated insights across the FOAA org.
   

  

 The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. The candidate is an expert with data modeling, ETL design and business intelligence tools and passionately partners with the business to identify strategic opportunities where improvements in data infrastructure creates out\-sized business impact. The candidate is a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), and enjoys working in a fast\-paced and global team. We're excited to talk to those up to the challenge!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and critical thinker with advanced problem\-solving, data mining, and scripting (Python) skills.
* They enjoy collaborating with top data engineers, BIEs, product managers and software developers to make decisions for Amazon's retail and operations teams.
* The candidate will be responsible for metrics, dashboards, and measurement across Promise platforms and fulfillment signal products to help improve evaluate inventory, fulfillment capabilities, and carrier capabilities.
* Your work will have a direct impact on Amazon's business and customer promise.


**About The Team**
 Amazon's Finance Operations, Accounting \& Analysis (FOAA) team is a fast\-paced, team\-focused, dynamic environment and delivering great experiences for our customers is top priority. FOAA is seeking a Finance Analyst to support our Accounting Onboarding team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience

* 3\+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets

title: Finance Six Sigma Black belt, Amazon Customer Excellence Services (ACES)
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Customer Excellence Services (ACES) team leads the identification and implementation of high\-impact initiatives to continuously improve Finance Global Business Services (FGBS) accounts payables operations. Based in Pune, this role drives tangible cost savings initiatives, manages Lean \- Six Sigma improvement project portfolios, and fosters an innovative culture while maintaining customer obsession.
   

  

 You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire delivery lifecycle as an integral part of how you plan, coordinate, track, communicate, and deliver. From generating and stress\-testing program plans, to automating status aggregation across workstreams, producing launch readiness assessments and synthesizing post\-launch operational data into actionable improvements, you will set the standard for AI\-augmented program delivery.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership
   

  

* Partner with Learning \& Development, Business Analytics, Business Partners and Finance teams to drive process improvements.
* Align local and global Amazon Customer Experience Solutions (ACES) initiatives with Financial Global Business Services (FGBS) goals


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Lead continuous improvement projects including Six Sigma, Lean, Kaizen, and Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)
* Mentor team members on improvement projects and Just Do It (JDI) and replication initiatives.
* Analyze key process indicators to identify optimization opportunities.
* Conduct Gemba Walks to generate improvement ideas.
* Conduct prioritization sessions with stakeholders to align projects and priorities.


 Project Management
   

  

* Guide projects to successful completion through the DMAIC methodology leading or mentorship.
* Track and deliver measurable business benefits
* Develop and execute site\-wide communication strategies


 Development \& Culture
   

  

* Deliver technical training in Six Sigma, Kaizen, and FMEA methodologies
* Foster continuous improvement culture through coaching


 Problem Solving
   

  

* Resolve systemic process barriers
* Design solutions for complex operational challenges
* Prioritize projects based on business impact


**Systems \& Technical Awareness**
* Understand the systems landscape deeply from automation limitations to integration dependencies, and scaling factors. Leverage AI across the full program lifecycle: generating and stress\-testing program plans, mapping dependency chains, automating status aggregation, accelerating testing execution, producing launch readiness assessments, and translating post\-launch assessments into actionable recommendations.


**Metrics \& Judgment**
* Design measurement frameworks distinguishing output from outcome metrics. Identify the right input metrics, use AI to synthesise cross\-team inputs and identify early indicators of delivery risk, and drive decisions confidently when data is incomplete.


**Execution \& Results Delivery**
* Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver highly complex, large\-scale programs from initiation to delivery, on time and with quality. Use AI to extend capacity across the delivery lifecycle and learn systematically from outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Mentor Lean / six sigma Belt project and small improvement projects.
* Lead impactful belt projects.
* Deliver Lean / Six Sigma trainings.
* Identify new process improvement opportunities.
* Conduct Gemba Walks to identify process pain points and potential new projects.
* Connects with leaders to align priorities and to identify process improvement needs


**About The Team**
 FGBS ACES, established in 2011, is comprised of 50\+ process improvement experts (Black Belts, Master Black Belts, Lean experts and data specialists) whose core competencies include: Value stream mapping, Root Cause Analysis, Data Analysis, Process Design, light automations and Change Management. This global team spans nine countries and is structured along FinOps verticals (i.e., Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivables, and Payroll) and business channels (i.e., AWS, Advertising, Stores, Healthcare etc.). FGBS ACES provides support across all of FGBS and various Amazon businesses, with the exception of Fulfillment Operations, HR, and Customer Service. Our team is actively engaged in projects across a wide range of areas, including Advertising, AWS, Stores, Tax, Transportation, and Treasury. In the past, we have also worked in Devices, Studios, Video, and Fresh.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* 4\+ years of program or project management experience
* Six Sigma Black Belt Certification
* Demonstrated, active use of AI tools across the program delivery lifecycle, not just awareness, but proven application in planning, tracking, communication, risk identification, or launch coordination


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience designing and embedding AI\-augmented workflows into program delivery (e.g., automated status synthesis, AI\-generated launch readiness assessments, predictive risk models)
